relationships.subject: AIBP
relationships.evidence_quote: Accordingly, we observed increased phosphorylation of TRPV1 in the DRG tissue from mice treated with paclitaxel and lower phosphorylation levels of TRPV1 after AIBP treatment (Figure 5B).

relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: isolated from paclitaxel/saline mice had significantly higher levels of lipid rafts and surface TLR4 expression compared to those from naïve/saline mice

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Further, the proximity between TRPV1 and TLR4, measured by PLA in DRG neurons, was also increased in paclitaxel CIPN mice and reversed by i.t. AIBP.

key_findings: Paclitaxel CIPN increases DRG neuronal lipid rafts, TLR4 expression, TRPV1 phosphorylation and TRPV1-TLR4 proximity; i.t. AIBP reverses these and the mechanical allodynia.
AIBP reduces capsaicin-evoked calcium responses in DRG neurons from paclitaxel-treated mice.
